nodes.name: Every minute
nodes.notes: Fires once a minute. Vercel's Hobby plan only supports daily crons in vercel.json, so this n8n trigger provides the tight enforcement for the 3h+5min auto clock-out.

nodes.name: Call /api/cron/auto-clock-out
nodes.notes: Header credential must send `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` — same value as the CRON_SECRET env var in Vercel.

nodes.name: Only when something closed
nodes.notes: Skips the noisy 'nothing to close' minutes. Downstream nodes only fire when the cron actually closed at least one session.

meta.description: Hits /api/cron/auto-clock-out every minute with the CRON_SECRET bearer header so non-admin sessions past 3h+5min get auto-closed even when the user closed the browser tab. Replace the `Romega Cron Bearer` credential (httpHeaderAuth, value=`Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`) before activating. Pair the 'Format summary' Code node with a Slack/Gmail node downstream if you want an audit ping.
